description: Public SEPTA developer APIs for Regional Rail arrivals, TrainView, Next-to-Arrive, and schedules; bus and trolley locations, detours, schedules, and stops; service alerts, elevator outages, and GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds. The documentation does not claim uniform real-time vehicle coverage for subway/elevated lines.
resolution_notes: base_url—keep original: official JSON is live at https://www3.septa.org/api/TrainView/index.php and SEPTA's catalog uses www3 endpoints. docs_url—change: the current documentation is https://api.septa.org/. example—replace with the working TrainView curl and live-format response from https://www3.septa.org/api/TrainView/index.php. description—change: https://api.septa.org/ lists Regional Rail, bus/trolley, alerts, elevator, and GTFS endpoints, but no general subway/elevated vehicle-location API.
